commitment: written before the model starts; the raw SHA-256 of this file's bytes is recorded in the campaign report and the fixed order is never re-decided
scope: ONE actual starting state (shared_after_bowl, scene seed 0 / init state 0: the exact recorded 102-action bowl prefix) measured at TWO model seeds; this is not a statistical reliability claim and no success rate is inferred

fixed_spec.instruction: put the wine bottle on the rack

preparation_limits.note: only the three fixed action bounds are raised, process-locally; every gain, clamp and tolerance is unchanged and no source file is edited

native_start_pose_target.note: the end-effector start-pose target is a measured XYZ/orientation and does NOT guarantee the full robot joint configuration

limitations.assistant_preparation: branch B runs the accepted assistant open-loop preparation (0 VLA actions) after the recorded bowl prefix; it is not a learned VLA skill
limitations.recorded_policy_replay: the 102-action bowl prefix is the preserved recorded-policy replay, not a freshly generated VLA bowl execution, a recovery or a forced release
limitations.one_starting_state: one actual starting state at two model seeds is not a statistical reliability claim and no success rate is inferred
limitations.joint_configuration: the end-effector start-pose target is a measured XYZ/orientation and does NOT guarantee the full robot joint configuration
limitations.no_repair: no assessment, repair, retry, forced release or Hermes call is performed
limitations.preparation_changes: Preparation changes end-effector position/orientation, gripper opening, robot velocities and elapsed simulation time. This A/B estimates the preparation procedure effect, not an isolated position-only or orientation-only causal effect. Objects are protected by the fixed displacement gate.
